### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

## AI is easy.
## Impact is hard.

That's where HCLTech makes the difference.
We turn AI into measurable business outcomes, from deployment to value and from insight to real
impact.

Our solutions are repeatable by design, responsible by default and engineered for scale. They are
shaped by our people who don't just build AI, but engineer it to deliver business outcomes in the
real world. Because anyone can promise AI. We build it to perform.

[Learn more][143]
[AI Leadership Report]

## The Blueprint for AI Leadership

### It's personal, not just technical

In our **3rd edition of The Blueprint series**, featuring 500 business and IT leaders, we reveal a
widening gap between organizations adopting AI and those realizing meaningful business value.

Only 18% of surveyed organizations say AI is delivering significant revenue impact, exposing a
critical gap between operational progress and business outcomes.

Learn how organizations are navigating the age of GenAI and identify specific shifts in strategy,
culture, data and architecture required to bridge the gap from experimentation to enterprise-wide
leadership.

[Download report][144]
[AI Force 2.0 to deliver enterprise-grade Agentic AI]

## Conversations with
## Pioneers of Enterprise AI

[[Episode 1 - How CTOs Scale AI and Build AI-Ready Workforces with Pearson]][145]

### Episode 1 - How CTOs Scale AI and Build AI-Ready Workforces with Pearson

Vijay Guntur, CTO and Head of Ecosystems at HCLTech, joins David Treat, CTO at Pearson to examine
why many AI initiatives fall short of expected returns and what leaders can do differently.

[[Episode 2- Reimagining the future of life sciences]][146]

### Episode 2 - Reimagining the future of life sciences

Kanda Natarajan, VP of IT at GSK, and Vijay Guntur, CTO and Head of Ecosystems at HCLTech, join
Sophia Zhang, SVP at Conde Nast to reflect on their experiences and highlight key lessons for
leaders.

[[Episode 3 - Scaling Enterprise AI beyond pilots]][147]

### Episode 3 - Scaling Enterprise AI beyond pilots

Ulf Axelsson Lejon, VP of Digital Business Transformation, Husqvarna Group and Dr. Mansoor
Samavatian, Technology & Delivery Partner, HCLTech discuss enterprise AI impact with Catherine
Crump, WIRED.

[[Episode 4- Modernizing Enterprise Legacy]][148]

### Episode 4 - Modernizing Enterprise Legacy

Johan Sporre, VP, Technology Foundation, Ericsson and Suresh Deshpande, AVP, HCLTech, discuss the
building blocks required to scale AI effectively with Charlie Burton, Director of Content, WIRED.

[[Episode 5 - Building a Physical AI strategy]][149]

### Episode 5 - Building a Physical AI strategy

In this episode, Rohan Davidson, CIO, Anglo American Group and Deepa Nittur, VP, HCLTech explore how
Physical AI is transforming operations with Catherine Crump from WIRED.

[[Episode 6: The strategic role of a trusted advisor in scaling AI]][150]

### Episode 6: The strategic role of a trusted advisor in scaling AI

Bijoy Sagar, Chief Information and Digital Officer, Bayer and Pankaj Tagra, Chief Growth Officer,
HCLTech discuss how AI can move from promise to practice with Michael Calore, WIRED.

and data engineering, IT operations and enterprise business processes to significantly improve and
accelerate business outcomes.

In our **3rd edition of The Blueprint series**, featuring 500 business and IT leaders, we reveal a
widening gap between organizations adopting AI and those realizing meaningful business value.

Only 18% of surveyed organizations say AI is delivering significant revenue impact, exposing a
critical gap between operational progress and business outcomes.

Learn how organizations are navigating the age of GenAI and identify specific shifts in strategy,
culture, data and architecture required to bridge the gap from experimentation to enterprise-wide
leadership.

Now's the time to move beyond bold ideas, turning new opportunities into action as industries
converge. That means using tech to accelerate progress and unlock new sources of value and growth.
We'll help you reinvent your business with AI, data, and cloud technology, so you can move faster

## Three ways to unlock new growth

As technology rapidly reshapes the world, new sources of value are emerging. Is your business ready
to capture the opportunity?

## - 3 items

[

## Shape your future with AI

Turn innovation into impact, moving from experiment to scale.

][305]
[

## Seize your opportunity

Unite human potential and AI power to reinvent your business.

][306]
[

## Capture new value

Be first to unlock growth in new places as industries converge.

][307]

## Decoding ROI from AI

Just 20% of companies are capturing 74% of all AI-driven value. We’ve decoded how, so you can
harness AI to drive productivity, reinvention, and growth.

[Learn more][308]

## Real stories. Real results.

### Medway NHS builds AI-powered contact solution to improve patient experience and resource use

Medway NHS Foundation Trust, located in Kent, operates the Medway Maritime Hospital. The hospital
wanted to improve care in the region and adapt resource use to deliver care more efficiently. PwC
was engaged to help improve the client-facing experience, focusing on the contact centre touchpoints
that patients had.

[Learn more][309]

### Engine by Starling: From launching a bank to launching a software business

PwC UK and Starling Bank are revolutionising the banking industry by offering Starling’s digital
platform, Engine, to banks around the world.

[Learn more][310]

### Supporting Global Payroll with Workday

Workday partnered with PwC to create a seamless, automated global payroll solution, ensuring
accurate, compliant pay across 31 countries, supporting rapid expansion and enhancing employee trust
worldwide.

[Learn more][311]

### Sharp takes on what’s next

### Careers

PwC is all about you. Whether you’re just starting out or are an experienced professional, your
future starts here.

[Explore PwC Careers][312]

### Press room

Get to know PwC’s leadership, keep up with our latest news, and find the regional contact person you
need.

### Medway NHS builds AI-powered contact solution to improve patient experience and resource use

Medway NHS Foundation Trust, located in Kent, operates the Medway Maritime Hospital. The hospital
wanted to improve care in the region and adapt resource use to deliver care more efficiently. PwC
was engaged to help improve the client-facing experience, focusing on the contact centre touchpoints
that patients had.

worldwide.

## A Practice Built
## for Cross-Border Complexity.

Founded in Dubai in 2020, Avyanco was built on a single conviction: that the world's most ambitious
founders deserve an advisor who can guide them across every market, not just one.

Unlike providers built to sell a single licence, we begin with your business — model, tax exposure,
ownership and expansion plans — then recommend the jurisdiction and structure that fit. Our
integrated practice delivers it end-to-end: formation, corporate structuring, tax, audit, compliance
and operational support under one partnership.

We serve founders raising capital in London, family offices structuring across the GCC, and
multinationals expanding into Saudi Arabia — across our eleven jurisdictions. We remain independent,
partner-led and accountable to our clients, so every recommendation follows commercial logic, never
a sales target.

How We Work

## From First Call to Fully Operational.

A structured six-step engagement — transparent at every stage, partner-supervised throughout.

01

### Initial Consultation

A partner-led call to understand your business model, target markets, and ownership objectives — no
obligation, no junior intake.

02

### Structure & Jurisdiction

Our partners recommend the optimal jurisdiction and legal structure — mainland, free zone, or
offshore — based on your commercial and tax position.

03

### Document Preparation

Every required document prepared: memoranda of association, shareholder agreements, notarisations,
attestations, and certified translations.

04

### Regulatory Submission

Applications submitted directly to the relevant authority — DET, DMCC, ADGM, DIFC, or any of the 45+
free zones we operate across.

05

### Licensing & Approvals

We coordinate with regulators, respond to queries, and track every approval milestone until your
trade licence is issued.

06

### Bank Account & Compliance

Corporate banking opened, visas processed, and your engagement transitioned to ongoing tax, audit,
and compliance support.

## Digital and AI insights

Shaping food and beverage innovation with AI

AI is redefining the food and beverage landscape – but success demands more than just data and
technology. It requires bold transformation across strategy, culture, talent and customer
engagement. In a market where speed and relevance are everything, discover how Baringa helps
businesses move faster, scale smarter, and lead with innovation.

[Explore how to lead with AI][116]

Architecting Loyalty in Financial Services

Your customers' expectations are rapidly shifting. Digital-first challengers are racing ahead, and
your outdated architectures are holding you back. To regain market share, you must create the
ultimate customer experience, lower your IT cost base, and embrace a new technology architecture. 

[Create the ultimate customer experience][117]

Digitising the Energy System

A new energy system is taking shape – one that’s much more complex, distributed, and dynamic than
anything seen before. In this new reality, vast potential exists for energy players to optimise
assets, transform trading, evolve customer experiences, and reduce costs, as companies ramp up
digitisation, deploy advanced technologies, and embrace data analytics and AI. Yet, fresh challenges
also emerge around cyber security, ethics, and privacy. To stay ahead and seize rewards,
organisations require new strategies, sophisticated tools, and the right expertise.

[Are you ready for energy’s new reality?][118]

Balancing Human and Tech in an AI World

Ever wondered what consumers' attitudes to AI are? We did too. That's why our TMT experts spent two
years surveying over 5,000 people worldwide to understand their honest feelings about AI.
[Discover the results][119]

Unlocking the Value of AI in Pharma

In today’s dynamic pharmaceuticals and life sciences environment, AI has the potential to be a
powerful driver of innovation, efficiency, and improved patient outcomes. But while investment is
high, many organisations are yet to translate that promise into real-world value. But how can pharma
leverage AI to accelerate both scientific and commercial outcomes?

[Leverage the true value of AI][120]

Unlocking the Potential of Digital and AI in the Public Sector

The UK public sector has the potential to unlock over £45 billion in annual savings and productivity
benefits through full digitisation of services. With AI and emerging technologies rapidly advancing,
there's a huge opportunity to leverage digital transformation for increased productivity and better
citizen services. Explore how you can have the confidence to maximise opportunities through clarity,
certainty, and continuous optimisation of outcomes in digital transformation.

[Discover how to achieve lasting impact][121]

Transforming customer service with AI

Exceptional service starts with understanding. AI enables organisations to deliver more human,
responsive and personalised experiences at scale. See how we help clients reimagine customer
journeys and build service models that drive satisfaction and loyalty.
[Make AI work for your customers][122]

# Is everyone asking you about AI? Let’s talk.

Business leaders face a barrage of questions. Do we have a clear vision and strategy? How much
investment is required and what return can we expect? What operational and technical challenges will
we face and do we have the right capabilities? Is our organisation ready for change on this scale?

Shaping food and beverage innovation with AI

AI is redefining the food and beverage landscape – but success demands more than just data and

engagement. In a market where speed and relevance are everything, discover how Baringa helps
businesses move faster, scale smarter, and lead with innovation.

your outdated architectures are holding you back. To regain market share, you must create the

Digitising the Energy System

anything seen before. In this new reality, vast potential exists for energy players to optimise
assets, transform trading, evolve customer experiences, and reduce costs, as companies ramp up
digitisation, deploy advanced technologies, and embrace data analytics and AI. Yet, fresh challenges
also emerge around cyber security, ethics, and privacy. To stay ahead and seize rewards,
organisations require new strategies, sophisticated tools, and the right expertise.

powerful driver of innovation, efficiency, and improved patient outcomes. But while investment is
high, many organisations are yet to translate that promise into real-world value. But how can pharma
leverage AI to accelerate both scientific and commercial outcomes?

[Leverage the true value of AI][120]

Unlocking the Potential of Digital and AI in the Public Sector

The UK public sector has the potential to unlock over £45 billion in annual savings and productivity
benefits through full digitisation of services. With AI and emerging technologies rapidly advancing,
there's a huge opportunity to leverage digital transformation for increased productivity and better
citizen services. Explore how you can have the confidence to maximise opportunities through clarity,
certainty, and continuous optimisation of outcomes in digital transformation.

[Discover how to achieve lasting impact][121]

### Dan Sarver

#### Managing Director

With over 30 years of experience in Corporate Finance, Mergers and Acquisitions, Accounting, and
Financial Analysis, Dan is a highly accomplished finance professional known for his strategic vision
and exceptional leadership.  He has a proven track record of successfully executing complex business
transactions including divestitures, management buyouts, balance sheet restructurings, and
shareholder transactions.
 

[Learn More][19]

> I enjoy working in mergers and acquisitions because it allows me to help family and founder-owned
> businesses achieve their goals and secure their legacy. Our dedication to personalized service and
> deep industry expertise ensures that our clients receive the best possible outcomes, making us a
> trusted partner in their most important transactions.

[Dave, a founding member of Confluence Advisors, with 35+ years of experience in investment banking
and M&A]

### Dave Eichenlaub

#### Managing Director

Dave has over 25 years of diverse experience in Corporate Finance, Mergers and Acquisitions,
Business Strategy, Business Advisory and Public Accounting. Dave leads and participates in numerous
types of transactions, including management buyouts, acquisitions, shareholder transactions, balance
sheet restructurings, growth strategy, senior and subordinated debt placements and divestitures. His
industry expertise includes manufacturing, food and beverage, business services and financial
services. Dave has also served in senior level roles with commercial and investment banking firms
where he gained significant experience in serving large corporations and middle market businesses.
He began his career with a big four accounting firm. Dave is a Certified Public Accountant
(inactive) in Pennsylvania, and a General Securities Representative licensed (7 and 63) by FINRA.
 Dave is a Registered Representative of and Securities Products are offered through BA Securities,
LLC Member FINRA, SIPC.

[Learn More][20]

> With over 25 years of experience as a CPA and in mergers and acquisitions and banking, I take
> pride in leveraging my extensive knowledge to guide family and founder-owned businesses through
> successful transactions. Our deep commitment to integrity and precision makes us a trusted partner
> in securing your business's future.

[Chris, a senior advisor at Confluence Advisors, with 24 years of experience in mergers,
acquisitions, and capital raising.]

### Christian Harsch

#### Managing Director

Chris has spent 25 years representing businesses seeking to sell, raise capital or make
acquisitions.  His experience includes advising private business, private equity held business and
publicly traded companies in a variety of transactions including sales, corporate carve-outs,
cross-Atlantic transactions, shareholder transactions, management buyouts and mezzanine debt and
equity placements. Chris began his career in the securities industry with TD Waterhouse as a
Registered Representative where he was primarily responsible for developing new business. He is a
General Securities Representative licensed (7 and 63) by FINRA.  Chris is a Registered
Representative of and Securities Products are offered through BA Securities, LLC Member FINRA,
SIPC.  He has a BS from Clarion University of Pennsylvania and an MBA from the University of
Pittsburgh, graduating with honors in both cases.

[Learn More][21]

> Having spent over two decades in mergers and acquisitions, I am dedicated to providing insightful
> and reliable advice to our clients. My lifelong commitment to this field ensures that you receive
> expert guidance, making us a dependable choice for navigating complex transactions.

[Walt, a Confluence Advisors expert with 25+ years in distribution, manufacturing, and global
procurement operations.]

### Walter Rausch

#### Vice President of Business Development

Walt has over 25 years of business management and development experience in distribution and
manufacturing, including his tenure as President of Fisher Scientific’s Worldwide Strategic Sourcing
organization. He was responsible for the corporation’s $2 billion plus global procurement operation,
as well as supplier acquisitions and integration strategies. Walt’s unique operational expertise is
an asset to Confluence clients. Walt also brings considerable management, strategic sourcing, sales,
marketing, merchandising and supply chain experience to client engagements.

[Learn More][22]

> Drawing from my experience managing multi-billion dollar units of publicly traded companies and
> serving on the boards of privately held businesses, I am passionate about helping family and
> founder-owned businesses thrive. Our strategic approach and operational expertise make us a
> trusted ally in achieving your business objectives.

[Jereme, a Confluence Advisors professional with 10+ years in M&A, business development, and
corporate finance expertise.]

### Jereme Frey

#### Vice President

Jereme has over ten years of experience in Mergers and Acquisitions, Business Development and
Corporate Finance. As an integral part of the Confluence team, Jereme is responsible for transaction
execution, financial modeling and due diligence. Prior to joining the firm, Jereme worked as the
Director of Business Development for Prima Health Care and as an Analyst at EdgePoint Capital. He
started his career as an Analyst at Key Bank. These roles have contributed to his extensive
experience in leading business operations and transaction advisory. Jereme is a licensed attorney in
Ohio and a General Securities Representative licensed (79 and 63) by FINRA.

[Learn More][23]

> With a decade of experience in mergers and acquisitions, coupled with an MBA in finance and a law
> degree, I am devoted to delivering comprehensive and strategic solutions for our clients. Our
> multidisciplinary expertise ensures that we are a reliable partner in driving successful sale
> transactions for your business.

## MeetOur Team

[View All][18]
[Dan, a finance expert with 30+ years of experience in M&A, corporate finance, and shareholder
transactions]

### Dan Sarver

#### Managing Director

With over 30 years of experience in Corporate Finance, Mergers and Acquisitions, Accounting, and
Financial Analysis, Dan is a highly accomplished finance professional known for his strategic vision
and exceptional leadership.  He has a proven track record of successfully executing complex business
transactions including divestitures, management buyouts, balance sheet restructurings, and
shareholder transactions.
 

[Learn More][19]

> I enjoy working in mergers and acquisitions because it allows me to help family and founder-owned
> businesses achieve their goals and secure their legacy. Our dedication to personalized service and
> deep industry expertise ensures that our clients receive the best possible outcomes, making us a
> trusted partner in their most important transactions.

[Dave, a founding member of Confluence Advisors, with 35+ years of experience in investment banking
and M&A]

### Dave Eichenlaub

#### Managing Director

Dave has over 25 years of diverse experience in Corporate Finance, Mergers and Acquisitions,
Business Strategy, Business Advisory and Public Accounting. Dave leads and participates in numerous
types of transactions, including management buyouts, acquisitions, shareholder transactions, balance
sheet restructurings, growth strategy, senior and subordinated debt placements and divestitures. His
industry expertise includes manufacturing, food and beverage, business services and financial
services. Dave has also served in senior level roles with commercial and investment banking firms
where he gained significant experience in serving large corporations and middle market businesses.
He began his career with a big four accounting firm. Dave is a Certified Public Accountant
(inactive) in Pennsylvania, and a General Securities Representative licensed (7 and 63) by FINRA.
 Dave is a Registered Representative of and Securities Products are offered through BA Securities,
LLC Member FINRA, SIPC.

[Learn More][20]

> With over 25 years of experience as a CPA and in mergers and acquisitions and banking, I take
> pride in leveraging my extensive knowledge to guide family and founder-owned businesses through
> successful transactions. Our deep commitment to integrity and precision makes us a trusted partner
> in securing your business's future.

[Chris, a senior advisor at Confluence Advisors, with 24 years of experience in mergers,
acquisitions, and capital raising.]

### Christian Harsch

#### Managing Director

Chris has spent 25 years representing businesses seeking to sell, raise capital or make
acquisitions.  His experience includes advising private business, private equity held business and
publicly traded companies in a variety of transactions including sales, corporate carve-outs,
cross-Atlantic transactions, shareholder transactions, management buyouts and mezzanine debt and
equity placements. Chris began his career in the securities industry with TD Waterhouse as a
Registered Representative where he was primarily responsible for developing new business. He is a
General Securities Representative licensed (7 and 63) by FINRA.  Chris is a Registered
Representative of and Securities Products are offered through BA Securities, LLC Member FINRA,
SIPC.  He has a BS from Clarion University of Pennsylvania and an MBA from the University of
Pittsburgh, graduating with honors in both cases.

[Learn More][21]

> Having spent over two decades in mergers and acquisitions, I am dedicated to providing insightful
> and reliable advice to our clients. My lifelong commitment to this field ensures that you receive
> expert guidance, making us a dependable choice for navigating complex transactions.

[Walt, a Confluence Advisors expert with 25+ years in distribution, manufacturing, and global
procurement operations.]

### Walter Rausch

#### Vice President of Business Development

Walt has over 25 years of business management and development experience in distribution and
manufacturing, including his tenure as President of Fisher Scientific’s Worldwide Strategic Sourcing
organization. He was responsible for the corporation’s $2 billion plus global procurement operation,
as well as supplier acquisitions and integration strategies. Walt’s unique operational expertise is
an asset to Confluence clients. Walt also brings considerable management, strategic sourcing, sales,
marketing, merchandising and supply chain experience to client engagements.

[Learn More][22]

> Drawing from my experience managing multi-billion dollar units of publicly traded companies and
> serving on the boards of privately held businesses, I am passionate about helping family and
> founder-owned businesses thrive. Our strategic approach and operational expertise make us a
> trusted ally in achieving your business objectives.

[Jereme, a Confluence Advisors professional with 10+ years in M&A, business development, and
corporate finance expertise.]

### Jereme Frey

#### Vice President

Jereme has over ten years of experience in Mergers and Acquisitions, Business Development and
Corporate Finance. As an integral part of the Confluence team, Jereme is responsible for transaction
execution, financial modeling and due diligence. Prior to joining the firm, Jereme worked as the
Director of Business Development for Prima Health Care and as an Analyst at EdgePoint Capital. He
started his career as an Analyst at Key Bank. These roles have contributed to his extensive
experience in leading business operations and transaction advisory. Jereme is a licensed attorney in
Ohio and a General Securities Representative licensed (79 and 63) by FINRA.

[Learn More][23]

> With a decade of experience in mergers and acquisitions, coupled with an MBA in finance and a law
> degree, I am devoted to delivering comprehensive and strategic solutions for our clients. Our
> multidisciplinary expertise ensures that we are a reliable partner in driving successful sale
> transactions for your business.

## Frequently asked questions

## What does Marsh do?

Marsh helps organizations navigate risk, develop their people, build their strategies to help them
thrive. With more than 95,000 colleagues in over 130 countries, we deliver expertise across risk,
reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting.

## What industries does Marsh serve?

We serve clients across a wide range of industries, including financial services, healthcare,
energy, manufacturing, construction, technology, retail, transportation, and the public sector.

## How is Marsh different from other professional services firms?

We bring together distinct capabilities across risk, strategy, and people. This means we can connect
data, insights, and solutions from across our firm to address our clients’ most complex challenges
and opportunities.

## I already work with one of your businesses. Can I access services from your other businesses?

Yes. Many of our clients work with multiple Marsh businesses to address interconnected challenges.
Your current team can introduce you to colleagues across Marsh.

## Is Marsh the same as Marsh McLennan?

Marsh McLennan changed its brand to Marsh effective January 2026. Marsh, our insurance broker, is
now known as Marsh Risk. Our other businesses will adopt the Marsh brand following a transition
period. This is a change to our brand strategy, not our business structure. We will continue to
serve clients as we do today across risk, strategy, and people.

## Is the stock ticker symbol changing?

Yes. Our stock ticker symbol changed from MMC to MRSH on the New York Stock Exchange in January
2026. [Learn more.][16]

# A Cut Above

Heritage Artificial Turf covers residential, commercial, sports, and pet applications. It's durable,
low-maintenance, and designed for the Midwest climate, making it the smart choice for every
landscape professional.

[Discover H.A.T. Products][33]
[ICON]

# Residential

This top-notch turf is ideal for residential lawns. Rest assured, your project will showcase
premium, PFAS-Free turf that flawlessly emulates natural grass.

[ICON]

# Commercial

Our long-lasting products endure the test of time, retaining their pristine appearance well beyond
installation. Safety is our top priority, reflected in our thorough third-party testing to ensure
our turf is free from PFAS.

[ICON]

# Golf

Transform your customer's outdoor space into a golfing oasis with superior attention to detail. Our
PFAS Free products are crafted to match every golfer’s needs. Whether you are looking for a
conversation piece or a tour-grade quality putting green, you can bring their golf game home!

[ICON]

# Sports

With our extensive range of products, we have everything you need for your next sports application,
whether indoor or outdoor. Our range of turf boasts superior durability, capable of withstanding
whatever you throw, hit, or slide on them. Keep your customers and athletes safe with our PFAS-Free
turf.

[ICON]

# Pets

Our artificial turf is specifically designed with pets in mind. Our products are engineered to
resist absorption, drain quickly with an industry-leading drainage rate of 505 gallons per hour per
square yard, and boast extra durability, all while being PFAS-free.

[ICON]

# Playground

Ensure your turf installation is safe for all with our PFAS-Free turf. Featuring unrivaled natural
colors, your project will stand out above the rest. Our fibers are designed to withstand
high-traffic family or playground play, ensuring your project maintains its pristine appearance from
installation onward.

Heritage Landscape Supply offers a wide variety of professional products to elevate your green
outdoor spaces. Whether it’s ornamental maintenance or extensive vegetation management, Heritage has

As the world moves closer towards renewable sources of energy, we here at enPossibilities work to

#### Frazer-Nash Consultancy develops landmark innovation to make UK electricity network smarter and

## Inclusion and Belonging

**We are committed to fostering a working culture that brings out the very best in our people.**

Our people are at the very heart of what we do, they are the reason our clients work with us to
solve some of their greatest challenges. At Frazer-Nash, we want all of our people to feel they
belong, confident in the knowledge that we value and respect the commitment they have made by
entrusting their careers and expertise to us.

We are committed to fostering a working culture that brings out the very best in our people,
regardless of their circumstances, identity or background. We want our people to be themselves, feel
empowered to achieve their personal and professional goals, and know that we respect the unique
value they bring to the company.

## Founder & Managing Director

## K.S Nandakumar

Mr Nandakumar KS is an entrepreneur based out of Bangalore, India. He’s founded and has been
successfully leading M/s Infinios Business Solutions (India) Pvt Ltd.

He has more than 03 decades of rich professional experience of in various organizations like ABB,
MAIT, Infinios & BICSI. While he started his career in ABB, he established himself as a successful &
credible professional in MAIT. In about 02 decades in MAIT, he has been credited to have
spearheading enduring campaigns in promotion of the Information Technology Industry in India. Mr.
Nandakumar developed a strong professional working between the Industry & State Governments in the
formative years in 1990s of IT industry in India. He was instrumental in setting up the first
Regional Office for an IT Industry in Bangalore in 1996 & subsequently establishing MAIT as an
efficient link-point for the IT Industry in South India.

In last one decade, he has conceptualized, and implemented the Marketing Process Outsourcing (MPO)
and established Infinios as reliable name in IT & ICT industry for successful delivery of outsourced
marketing shared services across India.

As he continues to embrace the evolving dynamics of the modern AdTech landscape, Mr. Nandakumar has
also been recently inducted into the Leadership Committee of BICSI India.

## OUR capabilities

## Why Choose us

At **Infinios**, we go beyond outsourcing — we become your trusted partner in growth. With deep
expertise across industries and global markets, we deliver scalable, transparent, and future-ready
solutions designed to maximize impact for enterprises and SMBs alike.

Our commitment lies in **long-term client relationships, measurable results, and accountable
delivery** that empower businesses to thrive in a competitive world.

MAIT, Infinios & BICSI. While he started his career in ABB, he established himself as a successful &
credible professional in MAIT. In about 02 decades in MAIT, he has been credited to have
spearheading enduring campaigns in promotion of the Information Technology Industry in India. Mr.
Nandakumar developed a strong professional working between the Industry & State Governments in the
formative years in 1990s of IT industry in India. He was instrumental in setting up the first
Regional Office for an IT Industry in Bangalore in 1996 & subsequently establishing MAIT as an

# Welcome to Jacobs

# Moving what matters

From cities and corridors to ports and people, Jacobs delivers the infrastructure, innovation and
design that keeps the world moving. We do more than build transportation systems. We move people,
goods and communities — safely and efficiently. 

[Explore We Move][191]
Previous Step Next Step

## Challenging today. 
## Reinventing tomorrow.

Jacobs is a global professional services company delivering science-based, digitally enabled,
end-to-end solutions — from consulting and advisory to design and implementation — across the
world’s most complex infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, environmental and technology
challenges.

We bring together the right services, expertise and technology to deliver forward-thinking and
sustainable solutions that are built to last.

# [A New Chapter for Kitchell Contractors: Phil Glenn Named President][4]


**Kitchell proudly announces the appointment of Phil Glenn as President of Kitchell Contractors, the
company’s general contracting business.**

Glenn, a 17-year Kitchell veteran and Arizona State University graduate, brings deep operational
expertise and a proven track record of leading teams and delivering complex projects. Over the
course of his career, he has led major projects for clients across the Southwest, including
Valleywise Health, Banner Health and CommonSpirit Health.

“Phil is a thoughtful, steady leader who understands our business, our clients, and what it takes to
deliver exceptional work,” said Wendy Cohen, Chief Executive Officer of Kitchell. “I have great
confidence in his leadership, his vision for the future and the continued momentum of our general
contracting business under his direction.”

Most recently, Glenn served as Vice President of Operations, where he oversaw operations for the
construction company nationwide, helping drive performance and strengthen teams across the business.

Throughout his tenure at Kitchell, Glenn has played a key role in delivering complex projects,
fostering strong client relationships and contributing to the company’s continued growth and
success.

In his new role as President, Glenn will oversee all aspects of Kitchell Contractors’ business, with
a continued focus on delivering high-quality outcomes for clients, supporting teams and advancing
the company’s strategic priorities.

“I’m honored to step into this role and grateful for the opportunity to continue building on the
strong foundation of this team,” said Glenn. “We have an aligned leadership group and a clear sense
of purpose. As we build on Kitchell’s 75-year legacy, we will continue to invest in our people,
strengthen our culture, and deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients.”

With strong momentum across the business, Kitchell Contractors is well positioned to continue
delivering high-quality work and building on its long-standing client relationships.

# [Kitchell Announces Sale of American Refrigeration Supplies][5]

**READ MORE** in the **Phoenix Business Journal**: [*Kitchell sells HVAC subsidiary to Pennsylvania
firm, shits focus*][6]

### ***Strategic transaction positions Kitchell to invest more deeply in its construction,
### consulting, and development enterprises***

PHOENIX — Kitchell, a leading builder, construction manager, capital program manager, and real
estate developer, has completed the sale of American Refrigeration Supplies, Inc. (ARS), its HVAC-R
wholesale distribution business, to Hajoca, one of the largest privately held wholesale distributors
of plumbing, HVAC, pool, and industrial supplies. The transaction closed on January 30.

The transaction reflects Kitchell’s long-term strategy to focus its resources where the company
delivers the greatest value across the built environment.

“The HVAC-R distribution market has continued to evolve, and we determined the timing was right to
transition ARS to an owner whose core focus is distribution,” said Wendy Cohen, president and CEO of
Kitchell. “This decision allows Kitchell to invest more deeply in growing our core construction,
consulting, and development enterprises, while positioning ARS to continue building on its strong
legacy.”

Since acquiring ARS in 1970, Kitchell has supported the 85-year-old company through decades of
growth, expanding its footprint to 34 branches and two distribution centers across seven states.

“ARS has built a strong reputation through its people, relationships, and service,” Cohen added.
“We’re proud of what the team has accomplished and confident Hajoca is the right long-term home to
support the next chapter of the business.”

Consistent with Hajoca’s people-focused operating philosophy, ARS will continue to operate under its
established brand and be led by its local leadership team.

“ARS is a natural fit with Hajoca,” said Rick Fantham, president and CEO of Hajoca. “We look forward
to supporting the team’s continued success and see them thrive for decades to come.”

[www.kitchell.com][7].

# [A New Chapter for Kitchell Contractors: Phil Glenn Named President][4]


**Kitchell proudly announces the appointment of Phil Glenn as President of Kitchell Contractors, the
company’s general contracting business.**

Glenn, a 17-year Kitchell veteran and Arizona State University graduate, brings deep operational
expertise and a proven track record of leading teams and delivering complex projects. Over the
course of his career, he has led major projects for clients across the Southwest, including
Valleywise Health, Banner Health and CommonSpirit Health.

“Phil is a thoughtful, steady leader who understands our business, our clients, and what it takes to
deliver exceptional work,” said Wendy Cohen, Chief Executive Officer of Kitchell. “I have great
confidence in his leadership, his vision for the future and the continued momentum of our general
contracting business under his direction.”

Most recently, Glenn served as Vice President of Operations, where he oversaw operations for the
construction company nationwide, helping drive performance and strengthen teams across the business.

Throughout his tenure at Kitchell, Glenn has played a key role in delivering complex projects,
fostering strong client relationships and contributing to the company’s continued growth and
success.

In his new role as President, Glenn will oversee all aspects of Kitchell Contractors’ business, with
a continued focus on delivering high-quality outcomes for clients, supporting teams and advancing
the company’s strategic priorities.

“I’m honored to step into this role and grateful for the opportunity to continue building on the
strong foundation of this team,” said Glenn. “We have an aligned leadership group and a clear sense
of purpose. As we build on Kitchell’s 75-year legacy, we will continue to invest in our people,
strengthen our culture, and deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients.”

With strong momentum across the business, Kitchell Contractors is well positioned to continue
delivering high-quality work and building on its long-standing client relationships.

# [Kitchell Announces Sale of American Refrigeration Supplies][5]

**READ MORE** in the **Phoenix Business Journal**: [*Kitchell sells HVAC subsidiary to Pennsylvania
firm, shits focus*][6]

### ***Strategic transaction positions Kitchell to invest more deeply in its construction,
### consulting, and development enterprises***

PHOENIX — Kitchell, a leading builder, construction manager, capital program manager, and real
estate developer, has completed the sale of American Refrigeration Supplies, Inc. (ARS), its HVAC-R
wholesale distribution business, to Hajoca, one of the largest privately held wholesale distributors
of plumbing, HVAC, pool, and industrial supplies. The transaction closed on January 30.

The transaction reflects Kitchell’s long-term strategy to focus its resources where the company
delivers the greatest value across the built environment.

“The HVAC-R distribution market has continued to evolve, and we determined the timing was right to
transition ARS to an owner whose core focus is distribution,” said Wendy Cohen, president and CEO of
Kitchell. “This decision allows Kitchell to invest more deeply in growing our core construction,
consulting, and development enterprises, while positioning ARS to continue building on its strong
legacy.”

Since acquiring ARS in 1970, Kitchell has supported the 85-year-old company through decades of
growth, expanding its footprint to 34 branches and two distribution centers across seven states.

“ARS has built a strong reputation through its people, relationships, and service,” Cohen added.
“We’re proud of what the team has accomplished and confident Hajoca is the right long-term home to
support the next chapter of the business.”

Consistent with Hajoca’s people-focused operating philosophy, ARS will continue to operate under its
established brand and be led by its local leadership team.

“ARS is a natural fit with Hajoca,” said Rick Fantham, president and CEO of Hajoca. “We look forward
to supporting the team’s continued success and see them thrive for decades to come.”

**About Kitchell**
Founded in 1950, Kitchell Corporation is a privately held company specializing in construction, real
estate development and related services. For 75 years, Kitchell has been a leader in the industry,
delivering innovative solutions across the built environment. Kitchell provides a broad range of
services nationwide, including general contracting, capital program and project management,
facilities consulting, development, property management and more. The company is consistently ranked
among the top firms both regionally and nationally. For more information, please visit
[www.kitchell.com][7].

**About Hajoca**
Founded in 1858, Hajoca currently consists of 450+ locally-managed locations operating under 60+
different regionally established trade names all committed to serving our customers with a
best-in-class experience. Hajoca combines the scale and resources of a national company with the
relationships and local decision-making of independent businesses. For more information, please
visit [www.hajoca.com][8].

a natural progression to be able to offer our clients a broad spectrum of services to elevate their
business and achieve excellence across the board.

### A guide to becoming certified

Learn how to become MCS certified through our free interactive e-learning platform.

[ Visit the platform ][159]

### MCS for **consumers**

Your guide to renewable energy. Find information about technologies like solar panels, heat pumps,
and battery storage. Learn what to expect from an MCS certified installation, read about the
financial support available, and find certified installers you can trust.

[ Visit now ][160]
[Couple sat on couch.]

### MCS for **installers**

A comprehensive resource for both aspiring and certified renewable energy installers. Find guidance
on becoming MCS certified, access the Standards Library and Product Directory, learn about training,
and access support for transitioning to the redeveloped Scheme.

[ Visit now ][161]
[Installer working on unit indoors]

### MCS for **product**

Understand the benefits of MCS certification and the steps to gain our mark. Access guidance on
recognised standards, explore the Product Directory, and learn how to showcase your products to
customers and installers across the UK.

[ Visit now ][162]
[Installers fitting a solar panel.]
WHAT WE DO

## MCS: giving everyone confidence in
## home-grown energy

MCS is the UK’s quality mark for small-scale renewable energy technologies like solar panels, heat
pumps, and battery storage. We have two main roles – setting and maintaining standards, and
providing consumer protection. 

Our standards define how renewable energy technologies should be designed and installed using MCS
certified products – they are a benchmark for quality developed in close consultation with industry.

panels, heat pumps, battery storage, and more.

installer.

See how we’re driving up standards, improving quality and enhancing consumer protection with the
redevelopment of our installer Scheme.

# MCS

### The UK’s quality mark for small-scale renewables

We’re here to give everyone confidence in home-grown energy

[ Who we are ][156]
[Installer smiling at camera in hi-vis.]
MCS

### Industry recognised standards

Our installer and product standards are a benchmark for quality

[ Our standards ][157]
[Installer and homeowner.]
MCS

### Find a trusted installer

Find an MCS certified installer in your area

[ Find an installer ][158]
[Installer stood infront of home.]
MCS

### A guide to becoming certified

Learn how to become MCS certified through our free interactive e-learning platform.

[ Visit the platform ][159]

### MCS for **consumers**

Your guide to renewable energy. Find information about technologies like solar panels, heat pumps,
and battery storage. Learn what to expect from an MCS certified installation, read about the
financial support available, and find certified installers you can trust.

[ Visit now ][160]
[Couple sat on couch.]

### MCS for **installers**

A comprehensive resource for both aspiring and certified renewable energy installers. Find guidance
on becoming MCS certified, access the Standards Library and Product Directory, learn about training,
and access support for transitioning to the redeveloped Scheme.

[ Visit now ][161]
[Installer working on unit indoors]

### MCS for **product**

Understand the benefits of MCS certification and the steps to gain our mark. Access guidance on
recognised standards, explore the Product Directory, and learn how to showcase your products to
customers and installers across the UK.

[ Visit now ][162]
[Installers fitting a solar panel.]
WHAT WE DO

## MCS: giving everyone confidence in
## home-grown energy

MCS is the UK’s quality mark for small-scale renewable energy technologies like solar panels, heat
pumps, and battery storage. We have two main roles – setting and maintaining standards, and
providing consumer protection. 

Our standards define how renewable energy technologies should be designed and installed using MCS
certified products – they are a benchmark for quality developed in close consultation with industry.

[MCS staff group photo outside.]
[Battery icon GIF] [Battery Icon]

### Our technologies

Find out more about the range of renewable energy technologies certified by MCS, including solar
panels, heat pumps, battery storage, and more.

[ View technologies ][163]
[MCS Icon - Contractor]

### Become MCS certified

Unlock new business opportunities and enhance your credibility by becoming an MCS certified
installer.

[ Becoming certified ][164]
[Clipboard icon.]

### Scheme redevelopment

See how we’re driving up standards, improving quality and enhancing consumer protection with the
redevelopment of our installer Scheme.

[ Find out more ][165]
[Wind Turbines Animated Icon] [Small wind icon.]

### Product certification

Looking to certify your product? Start the process now to gain MCS certification.

[ FIND OUT MORE ][166]
TRAINING AND SKILLS

## MCS approved training courses

Find MCS an approved training course near you that meets our competency requirements.

[Find a training course ][167]
[Installers holding a proud to be an MCS certified battery storage contractor sign.]

### The MCS Data Dashboard

Access real-time certification data and insights on the UK’s progress to adopting renewable energy.

[ FIND OUT MORE ][168]

## About MCS Landscape Services

][52]
* [Start a Project][53]
* [MCS Deliveries][54]
* [Find a Professional][55]

### Quality, Service, and Knowledge

MCS Landscape Supply is a family owned and operated business since 1972. We pride ourselves in
taking care of our customers through useful services and great product knowledge. We welcome
everybody from do-it-yourself homeowners to contractors﻿ for projects of any size. We provide your
hardscape needs from start to finish which include hardscapes, installation materials, loose
materials, tools, and accessories. Our products offer a large variety of colors, textures, sizes,
and patterns.

[

## Pavers

][56]
* [Patio][57]
* [Pathway][58]
* [Driveway][59]
* [Circle Kits][60]


Pavers are great a great option for any outdoor patio, pathway, driveways and more. These are one of
the main design elements when creating your outdoor living space. Pavers offer a large variety of
sizes, textures, and colors for any project.

[

## Wall Systems

][61]
* [Retaining Walls][62]
* [Freestanding Walls][63]
* [Garden Walls][64]


Walls add design and functionality, allowing for flexibility in the creation of raised patios,
outdoor steps, seating walls and more. Garden walls are great for DIY Projects, freestanding walls
divide outdoor spaces while adding additional seating, and retaining walls are structural walls that
can be built to needed lengths and heights.

[

## Rock and Mulch

][65]
* [Decorative Rock][66]
* [Mulch & Soils][67]
* [Sand & Gravel][68]
* [Boulders & Flagstone][69]


Rock and mulch are two easy ways to add curb appeal to your landscaping project. We carry a variety
of decorative rocks, recycled wood chip mulch, and cedar mulches. Soils can help you grow a range of
plants, fruits, and veggies to sod. You can also purchase "Hybrid Texas Blue Grass" sod directly
shipped from the farm. Other options available upon request. Need delivery? We can deliver loose
materials!

[

## Outdoor Living

][70]
* [Firepits and Fireplaces][71]
* [Seating Walls][72]
* [Kitchen Kits][73]
* [Water Features][74]

### Outdoor Living

Outdoor Living Kits allow for a custom space, that fits your personal needs, leaving you with a
functional outdoor space. Outdoor living kits are great additions to any project. Kits include all
of the materials you will need, making them perfect for weekend projects. Check out our selection of
firepits, fireplaces, seating walls, kitchens and water features.

# Research-based, results-driven UX guidance and training.

## Live Online Courses

Learn live from expert instructors covering comprehensive UX topics — with optional
industry-recognized [UX Certification][27].

[All Live Online Courses][28]
* [AI for Design Workflows]
  Artificial Intelligence
  [ **AI for Design Workflows** ][29]
  
  Leverage AI to enhance creativity, efficiency, and impact in everyday design work
  
  Live Online
* [Usability Testing]
  Research
  [ **Usability Testing** ][30]
  
  Plan, conduct, and analyze your own studies, whether in person or remote
  
  Live Online

## Self-Paced Courses

Learn on your schedule — targeted, practical training on the industry’s most in-demand skills.

[All Self-Paced Courses][31]
* [SP_Thumbnails_8]
  4 Hours 16 Lessons
  [ **Demonstrating UX Value** ][32]
  
  Translate UX outcomes into business value to influence stakeholders and secure buy-in.
  
  US$ 199 Self-Paced
* [SP_Thumbnails_10]
  9.75 Hours 32 Lessons
  [ **Successful UX Job Searching** ][33]
  
  Secure your next UX job with a strategic plan, persuasive portfolio, and stellar interview skills.
  
  US$ 49 Self-Paced

## Earn UX Certification

### Take 5 live courses, pass 5 online exams

UX Certification is an exam-based credential that reinforces learning and boosts credibility.

[UX Certification Benefits][34]

## Recent Articles & Videos

### [UX-Context Design: Using UX Knowledge to Inform AI-Generated Design][35]

As more interface work is AI-generated, the output of research and design shifts from documents
written for humans to curated context that guides AI.

7 min read Tony Alicea

### [A Concrete Definition of “Product Sense” (and How to Build It)][36]

Product sense means predicting which product decisions will succeed based on patterns learned
through experimentation — and knowing when those patterns apply.

6 min read Tanner Kohler

### [Transitioning from Graphic Design to UX][37]

Moving from graphic design to UX doesn’t mean starting over. Most core skills are directly
transferable and serve as a strong foundation to become a great UX designer.

4 min video Megan Brown

### [4 Mistakes to Avoid When Presenting Complex UX Maps][38]

UX maps clarify complexity but are often presented poorly. Prepare audiences by communicating early,
speaking plainly, and focusing on collaborative outcomes.

4 min video Therese Fessenden
[More Articles & Videos][39]

## Learn with Your Team

Bring NN/G training to your team with our private team training courses delivered online or in
person. Or save with group discounts on our monthly live online courses and UX Certification exams.

[ Train Your Team ][40]
[A woman leading a workshop, gesturing toward the audience]

## Partner with Our Experts

Bring our consulting services to your team. Our industry experts will conduct research, advise on
strategy, or provide the support needed to elevate your team's work.

[ Explore Consulting Offerings ][41]
[A man focused on a laptop during a usability testing session]

## Why NNGroup
* ### Research-backed, 28+ years strong.
  
  We have over 28 years of experience and take pride in our reputation as the team whose research
  defines and advances UX. [Meet our team →][42]
* ### Deep topics, digestible guidance.
  
  We publish actionable research findings that cut through the noise, establishing industry best
  practices without jargon or inaccessible theory. [Explore our articles and videos →][43]
* ### Evidence over opinions.
  
  We don't cut corners — all our advice is built on extensive research, not industry vibes. It's why
  our clients keep coming back. [See our clients →][44]

## Leading Organizations Learn from NNGroup
* Visa
* P&G
* Citi
* [Amazon Logo]
* Vimeo
* Samsung

Get weekly UX articles, videos, upcoming courses, and job openings straight to your inbox with our
newsletter.

Submit unlimited requests within your chosen service areas. We'll tackle them sequentially, working
on as many requests simultaneously as possible on your subscription plan. Need more capacity? Simply

Receive complete ownership of all deliverables produced during our engagement, including source
files, research data, and implementation code. You'll also have access to premium tools, licenses,
and frameworks that power our solutions.

### No-obligation flexibility

Use our subscription for as long as you need and cancel anytime with no hidden fees or penalties.
Your subscription simply won't renew for the following month. Annual plans offer additional savings
while maintaining the same flexibility.

### Senior expertise at exceptional value

Access the top 0.5% of talent across design, conversion optimization and AI for a fraction of
traditional agency costs. From premium creative work to data-driven optimization and automation,
receive senior-level expertise without the price tag.

### Seamless integration

We adapt to your preferred workflow with dedicated project management. Whether you prefer ClickUp,
Slack, email, or your own project management tools, we'll integrate seamlessly with your team's
existing processes.

### Rapid, reliable delivery

Experience industry-leading turnaround times across all service areas. Typically, you'll receive
updates every 1-3 working days (depending on complexity), ensuring continuous progress on your
initiatives without unnecessary delays.

# The trust layer for professional hiring.

Build a verified professional profile with peer-validated credentials and a Trust Score that proves
what your CV claims.

[Build your profile][8][For employers][9]
[A professional reviewing trust-scored candidates inside POP]

The problem

## CVs are claims. POP is proof.

Hiring runs on assumptions about credibility. POP replaces those assumptions with evidence —
verified, scored, and visible to both sides of the table.

### CVs are self-reported.

There's no signal between an honest claim and an inflated one — and reviewers can't tell the
difference at scale.

### References happen too late.

By the time anyone calls a reference, weeks of screening have already gone into a shortlist that may
not deserve it.

### No shared confidence signal.

Every employer reinvents how they assess credibility, and every professional has to prove themselves
from scratch.

How it works

## From CV to verified record in three steps.
1. 01
   
   ### Add your roles and credentials
   
   List the work you have done — employers, dates, responsibilities, qualifications, and the things
   you want recognised.
2. 02
   
   ### Get verified
   
   Confirm your corporate email, upload supporting documents, and invite the people you worked with
   to verify your roles.
3. 03
   
   ### Earn your Trust Score
   
   Every verified signal compounds. Your score grows with your reputation, and your profile becomes
   evidence employers can trust.

Trust Score

## A 0–100 score, made of evidence.

Your Trust Score reflects the strength and breadth of the independent confirmations behind your
profile. Every input is verifiable. Every contribution is explainable.

92Trust Score

Example score · 5 verified roles · 8 peer confirmations

For professionals

## Turn experience into verified credibility.

Your career is more than what fits on a CV. POP gives you a system of record for what you have
actually done — and the evidence to back it.
* ### A verified profile that travels with you
  
  Take ownership of your professional record. Your verified roles and credentials are yours, not
  locked inside a recruitment platform.
* ### Peer verification, the way references should work
  
  Invite the people you worked with to confirm your roles and contributions — independently, in
  their own words.
* ### A public Career Story
  
  A long-form, evidence-backed record of how you grew — beyond bullet points on a CV.
* ### Privacy-first contact
  
  Be discoverable without exposing your inbox. Vet inbound requests on your terms.

Every hour spent screening unverified applications is an hour you could have spent on the candidates
who deserve a real conversation. POP gives you that filter, before the shortlist.
* ### Shortlist on evidence, not assumption
  
  Every candidate carries a Trust Score and a transparent record of how it was earned. Decide who to

  Candidates surface based on verifiable signals about role fit — not just keyword density on a CV.

### At Sierra7, we live our Mission and Values everyday

Our Founder and CEO, Rafael Fagundo, started Sierra7 with the Mission to “Serve Those Who Serve”
through delivery of innovative healthcare and technology solutions. Learn more about Sierra7 and how
our Mission and Values enable us to deliver quality solutions to support our client’s mission.

### We empower our team members to be innovative leaders in their field

At Sierra7, we are focused on building a team of diverse leaders who are dedicated to our Mission
and Values and motivated to advance our client’s mission. We are committed to creating a positive
workplace environment that empowers our team members to find meaning in their work. Discover how a
career at Sierra7 can help you achieve your potential.

popularity.

to suggest the most relevant alternative websites. Each result is manually reviewed by our team for
accuracy and updated daily to ensure fresh, reliable suggestions.

## A One-Stop Shop For All Your Company Data Needs!
* COMPANY DATA
* AI
* B2B
* API
* REPORT

TradeAtlas’ global database provides the most up-to-date information about overseas importers and
exporters for companies aiming to make trade connections in international markets and monitor their
customers & competitors. The importers’ and exporters’ data on TradeAtlas is obtained from bill of
lading data and customs records. Therefore, all the information on the database comes from actual
and realized transactions.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][41]

With the Potential Importers solution, you can discover the companies that have not imported a
product or product group in the target market you have selected but have a very high potential to
import in a matter of seconds with nearly 100% accuracy. We provide the most suitable importer and
supplier companies for your export among millions of real companies via “Top-Matching Importers
Module” which is listed by evaluating many parameters such as import volumes, past import
transactions, geographical distance, import frequencies, interest levels and trade sizes.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][42]

TradeAtlas works closely with producers to promote their products internationally. We offer a
state-of-art marketing strategy powered by our own company-level data, which includes 20+ million
importers all over the world from 230 countries/territories, from USA to Papua New Guinea, from
Madagascar to Chile, from Yemen to the UK. We contact, negotiate and close sales for your products
on behalf of your company with our experienced team and dealers all over the world. Please contact
us for more details, including your products and website for a preliminary analysis.

[CONTACT US >>][43]

TradeAtlas features can be used through our simple REST API. Integrate with TradeAtlas API to
automatize your work with company-level international trade data. TradeAtlas API does 2 main jobs:
count feature (you can count how many Italian exporters are there who exports furniture to the USA)
and download feature (you can download all details of the Italian exporters who exports furniture to
the USA, including importer and exporter company names, prices, quantities, products, HS codes,
ports, and more, whichever available in our database). Please feel free to contact us for more
details, pricing, technical documents and a free trial.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][44]

TradeAtlas’ unique coverage of company-level international trade data, consists of 2+ billion lines
of transactions, could also be ordered via reporting feature (offline Excel/CSV files). Please
describe your need for trade route (for ex; I need shipments arriving to African continent from
EU-27 zone / or / all shipments leaving Chile to the world), product (for ex; I need all drug
shipments / or / I need all shipments under Chapter 70: Glass and glassware) and the period for the
shipments (during the last 12 months / or / from 2020 till the latest available data). Please feel
free to contact us for more details, pricing, shipments/company count and a sample file.

[CONTACT US >>][45]

TradeAtlas’ global database provides the most up-to-date information about overseas importers and
exporters for companies aiming to make trade connections in international markets and monitor their
customers & competitors. The importers’ and exporters’ data on TradeAtlas is obtained from bill of
lading data and customs records. Therefore, all the information on the database comes from actual
and realized transactions.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][41]

With the Potential Importers solution, you can discover the companies that have not imported a
product or product group in the target market you have selected but have a very high potential to
import in a matter of seconds with nearly 100% accuracy. We provide the most suitable importer and
supplier companies for your export among millions of real companies via “Top-Matching Importers
Module” which is listed by evaluating many parameters such as import volumes, past import
transactions, geographical distance, import frequencies, interest levels and trade sizes.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][42]

TradeAtlas works closely with producers to promote their products internationally. We offer a
state-of-art marketing strategy powered by our own company-level data, which includes 20+ million
importers all over the world from 230 countries/territories, from USA to Papua New Guinea, from
Madagascar to Chile, from Yemen to the UK. We contact, negotiate and close sales for your products
on behalf of your company with our experienced team and dealers all over the world. Please contact
us for more details, including your products and website for a preliminary analysis.

[CONTACT US >>][43]

TradeAtlas features can be used through our simple REST API. Integrate with TradeAtlas API to
automatize your work with company-level international trade data. TradeAtlas API does 2 main jobs:
count feature (you can count how many Italian exporters are there who exports furniture to the USA)
and download feature (you can download all details of the Italian exporters who exports furniture to
the USA, including importer and exporter company names, prices, quantities, products, HS codes,
ports, and more, whichever available in our database). Please feel free to contact us for more
details, pricing, technical documents and a free trial.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][44]

TradeAtlas’ unique coverage of company-level international trade data, consists of 2+ billion lines
of transactions, could also be ordered via reporting feature (offline Excel/CSV files). Please
describe your need for trade route (for ex; I need shipments arriving to African continent from
EU-27 zone / or / all shipments leaving Chile to the world), product (for ex; I need all drug
shipments / or / I need all shipments under Chapter 70: Glass and glassware) and the period for the
shipments (during the last 12 months / or / from 2020 till the latest available data). Please feel
free to contact us for more details, pricing, shipments/company count and a sample file.

system integration, and orchestration across a wide range of connected assets, enterprise
applications, and cloud services.

orchestration scenarios with unprecedented speed, significantly cutting the cost of integration and
product deployment, with the power to quickly deploy new services while keeping OPEX costs under
control.

# What Our Customers Are Saying

Real Business, Real Results – Dive into the Success Stories Straight from Our Esteemed Clients.

“Waylay has been a great and reliable partner in Atlas-Copco’s journey towards proactive asset
monitoring and to integrate asset health data into our service and customer processes. Together we
are avoiding 100+ customer disruptions around the globe.”

###### GLOBAL OPERATIONS SUPPORT - FLEET CONNECTIVITY AND DATA INITIATIVES, ATLAS-COPCO

“Waylay has proven to be a reliable, effective partner in re-launching our Asset Health Monitoring
offering for Tetra Pak Packaging and Processing equipment. Together we have achieved the successful
integration of secure technical data into some of our Service tools such as Service Cloud, and this
is already improving our Customers experience while adding value to our Remote support specialists
daily activities.”

###### ASSET HEALTH MONITORING MANAGER, TETRA PAK

“When we introduced Tata Communications MOVE™ as an intelligent, secure, context-driven connectivity
management platform, it immediately caught people's attention. The concept of a context-aware
platform piques their curiosity as it empowers them to craft personalized user journeys and
experiences. And that's where the automation that Waylay brings to our platform really matters and
it comes alive in all its forms, it goes beyond the user journeys. The flexibility of the platform
leaves them astonished, realizing the endless possibilities it offers. By making key decisions in
collaboration with our users, we have shaped Move to become one of the most cutting-edge and
advanced CMPs in the world.”

##### Avneesh Prakash

###### VP AND GLOBAL HEAD OF MOVE AND MOBILITY

“Our solution, powered by Waylay technology, combines the heuristic rules and artificial
intelligence to counter money laundering, payment frauds and insurance scams. Equipped with big data
processing capabilities and latest security & access control measures, it provides scale and
resiliency for handling millions of transactions a day."

“Waylay will support our customers' transition to cloud computing and propel the transformation of

July 2026
The development of Luzhniki as a major sports and public cluster is increasing the appeal of nearby
districts and influencing real estate values. New restaurants, services, landscaped embankments, and
sports infrastructure are creating a self-sufficient urban environment that buyers receive together
with their homes. Anna Danchenok, Head of Real Estate and Urban Development at Yakov & Partners,
notes that major points of attraction increase the intensity of business and social connections,
generating additional economic activity. International benchmarks suggest that housing near such
assets can command a 5–15% premium, while commercial rents may be 10–35% higher than in comparable
locations.
[TASS]
July 2026
Large-scale AI adoption could generate a total effect of around RUB 900 billion for construction and
real estate. According to Anna Danchenok, Partner at Yakov & Partners, this could offset
approximately 5–6% of the decline in developer margins and bring the industry closer to its 2022
performance levels. Around 64% of developers already use AI, most actively in sales. The next stage
will involve expanding AI into other processes where automation can improve productivity and reduce
costs.

districts and influencing real estate values. New restaurants, services, landscaped embankments, and
sports infrastructure are creating a self-sufficient urban environment that buyers receive together

notes that major points of attraction increase the intensity of business and social connections,
generating additional economic activity. International benchmarks suggest that housing near such
assets can command a 5–15% premium, while commercial rents may be 10–35% higher than in comparable
locations.

July 2026
Large-scale AI adoption could generate a total effect of around RUB 900 billion for construction and
real estate. According to Anna Danchenok, Partner at Yakov & Partners, this could offset
approximately 5–6% of the decline in developer margins and bring the industry closer to its 2022
performance levels. Around 64% of developers already use AI, most actively in sales. The next stage
will involve expanding AI into other processes where automation can improve productivity and reduce
costs.
